pages.text: SYN Business Review analyst note on Msitu Energy (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 101.28 for MSI4. The note cites steady demand in the energy sector and cost control at Msitu Energy (SYN). Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
